_about: Each shot says what it shows, so whoever retakes it, by hand or with the runner, knows what the picture must contain, and a stale one is easy to spot. Taking the docs' screenshots by hand is preferred for now, as choosing the save and the moment shows UI faults (the user, 2026-11-21); this list records the preferred saves and views, and doc_screenshots.py retakes them in bulk when a change touches many, such as a background style. The docs' screenshots doc_screenshots.py retakes: each image under _1_AdvCiv-SAS/Images, the save role it is taken on, the screen to open (a SASPilotUI uiopen name), the buttons or tabs to press by their text, an optional point to hover in the 1920 x 1080 game area (the real pointer goes there, so the game draws the tooltip; positions belong to the save, as they move with its leaders and resources), and presses that undo a toggle afterwards. Saves are local files and break across commits (KI#46), so they are named here by role; when one no longer loads, make a new one as described in the role's note and update its file name.

t201.note: Most screens: a Huge Pangaea autoplay loaded at turn 201, with our civ in the top 60% of the scoreboard but not leading: too weak, it has few techs, bonuses or wonders to show; too strong, the screens look one-sided. Research under way, so the tech bar shows SAS's tech icon, and no anarchy. Charlemagne ranks 6th of 15 here. Several tradeable resources, so the Bonuses tab's hover shows different prices.

t301.note: What comes late, such as corporations, and the Battles tab, which needs varied battles: different opponents, terrain and features such as hills, on land and at sea. The same game at turn 301.

sas48.note: SAS48 edge cases, such as the Espionage tab's compact rows: a 48-civ Pangaea autoplay at turn 101 to 151.
